b33.labelled: DESCRIPTIVE: the matched-condition count is small
b33.interval_matching: The GSE260996 treatment protocol states stimulus A for 4 h then stimulus B, so the omics interval is 4 h and only the 4 h trace arm is matched. LPS->LPS exists in the traces only at 8 h and is absent from the RNA series entirely, so it cannot enter this analysis.
b33.collection_time_after_stimulus_b: NOT STATED in either GEO record; matching is on stimulus identity and interval only, and this residual timing uncertainty is a limitation.
b33.ligand_code_cross_check: GSE261647's protocol gives LPS 1 ng/mL, CpG 100 nM, polyI:C 1 ug/mL, TNF 10 ng/mL, matching the deposit's own code comments exactly and independently confirming the F1.2 mapping.

b4.name: B4 cross-species: mouse priming-suppressed LPS genes vs human LPS tolerance
b4.preregistered_mismatch: The two contrasts are deliberately not the same biology: mouse is HETEROLOGOUS priming (CpG or polyI:C, then LPS, 4 h apart, BMDM) while human is HOMOLOGOUS tolerance (LPS, then LPS, 6 days apart, monocyte-derived macrophages). A null result is the expected outcome of comparing them and is not evidence about either one.
b4.mouse_source: GSE260996 RNA-seq counts, DESeq2 (v0 used the ATAC matrix here)
b4.human_source: GSE58310, moderated paired test (limma method), donor-paired
